# Ellipsoid Selection

Selects the part of your scene inside a sphere or stretched sphere, with optional soft edges.

`lfs.ellipsoid_selection` · Selection

## How to use

Set Centre and Radii to surround your target.  
Equal radii make a sphere; Falloff 0 gives a sharp boundary.  

## Inputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Centre | `Centre` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 0.01 | Centre in local scene units along X, Y and Z. The default (0, 0, 0) is the object's origin. |
| Radii | `Radii` | lfs.vector | [1.0, 1.0, 1.0] | min 0; step 0.01 | Radius along each axis in scene units, all non-negative. The default (1, 1, 1) makes a unit sphere. |
| Rotation | `Rotation` | lfs.vector | [0.0, 0.0, 0.0] | step 1 | Rotation around X, Y and Z in degrees. The default (0, 0, 0) leaves the orientation unchanged. |
| Falloff | `Falloff` | lfs.float | 0 | min 0; step 0.01 | Soft edge outside the ellipsoid, relative to its radii. 0, the default, gives a sharp boundary. |

## Outputs

| Name | Identifier | Type | Default | Range / choices | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Selection | `Selection` | lfs.float | — | — | Selection strength: 0 is unselected, 1 fully selected; values between them make soft transitions. |
